description: Regression for the fabricated-interval bug (2026-07-18). A continuous 13.49mi long run where the athlete PAUSED the watch at water breaks. The bout detector split it into 4 same-pace 'bouts' (incl. a 9-mile one) separated by standing stops. This is NOT an interval session — the notes are a plain auto-import with no workout declared, and the bouts show no hard/easy contrast. Must return a CONTINUOUS type (long_run/easy/progression), reps=null, intent_pattern=null (never the parser's own '4 work bouts…' summary), equivalent_race_pace=null. A single 9-mile 'rep' must never appear.
